findings.issue: The NL lemma assumes D has n ≥ 1 vertices (i.e. V(D) is nonempty), but the Lean formalization places no nonemptiness assumption on V (no `[Nonempty V]` or `0 < Fintype.card V`); the blowup theorems quantify over a possibly-empty vertex type.

The NL claims the construction works for ANY integer m > |V(D)|, but the Lean fixes the blowup size to exactly n + 1 (the immediate successor of |V(D)| = n), as confirmed by `Nat.lt_succ_self n`; it does not quantify over all m greater than |V(D)|.
